title: Explicit common-stage tensor data retaining component normalization
statement:
theorem completed_tensor_common_lift_normalized_tensor_unit
    (N : ∀ E, CompletedTensorFiniteModel l X R closed models E)
    (coherence : RingedDerivedTensorCoherence.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (ProEt.topology X) (ring l X R) closed models symmetry) :
    ∃ data : CompletedTensorCommonLiftTensorUnit l X R closed models symmetry,
      ∀ A B, data.tensor.hom.app (A, B) =
        (completedTensorCommonComponent l X R closed models N A B).hom

source.place: Remark 6.8.15, the actual tensor functor, together with HRS Lemma 7.9 (literature/hemo-richarz-scholbach-constructible-sheaves_arXiv-2305.18131.pdf), the natural finite-field colimit equivalence; the explicit component construction already present in AdicCompletedTensorCommonLiftTensorUnit.

proof.text: Obtain the ordinary coefficient-unit comparison and compose it with coherence.unitIso. Form the tensorator by NatIso.ofComponents from completedTensorCommonComponent, using its stated naturality theorem. Package these maps and retain the component equality, which holds by reflexivity. The tensorator is the explicit construction, not a witness chosen from an unnormalized Nonempty statement.
